about: Ratchet & Clank's binding for mods (docs/port/MODS.md, section 11): its hook points and the game state exposed to scripts by name. sdk/tools/gen_binding.py writes port/game/rac1/script_binding.c, sdk/include/openrac/games/rac1.hpp and sdk/types/rac1.d.luau from it, with the behaviour catalogue's update functions as hook points (experimental) and every hook point's permanent id and aliases (rac1.ids.lock); --check holds the hook points to the hook rows of port/game/rac1-<disc>/libraries.tsv. Addresses are each disc's; a field's offset is added to its base's.

catalogue_exclude.func_001E9768: Profile_Mark: an empty routine 46 classes take as their update, which the engine also calls as a profiler mark; a hook on it would run for every mark and never see a moby

hooks.name: Pad_ProcessReport
hooks.about: One pad report into the pad's state (PadState, at pad), each poll, before the tick reads it.

hooks.name: Hero_UpdateMotionInput
hooks.about: The stick read into the hero, early in his update each tick.

hooks.name: Hero_TurnToHeading
hooks.about: Eases the hero's facing toward his move yaw.

hooks.name: Hero_SetPlanarVelocity
hooks.about: The hero's velocity at his ground speed along an angle; an angle above pi means his facing.

hooks.name: FollowCamera_ApplyOverrides
hooks.about: The follow camera's per-tick requests from the hero's state; the camera moby's update calls it before it places the eye.

hooks.name: Hero_AdvanceAnimation
hooks.about: Ratchet's animation moved on by his animation speed, once a tick after his state's update.

hooks.name: Item_Give
hooks.about: Gives the player item id (GiveItem): sets its owned and obtained bytes, shows its banner, gives its starting ammo, marks it bought in the vendor's stock and adds it to the quick select; equip non-zero also puts it in hand. Every item the game gives goes through it but the Persuader's.

hooks.name: Planet_Unlock
hooks.about: Unlocks a planet's coordinates (UnlockPlanet): its flag (one byte per level), the galaxy list, and its banner unless it is the planet the player is on.

hooks.name: Vendor_InitLevelStock
hooks.about: The vendor's stock at each level start (VendorStockLevelInit): gives the Bomb Glove while the player has none, keeps the stock's known items and adds the level's new weapon.

hooks.name: Vendor_BuildItemList
hooks.about: The vendor menu's list (VendorBuildItemList), from the stock and the items owned: each time the menu opens and after each purchase. skip_unflagged leaves out what is for sale (the menu opened from the pause screen).

hooks.name: GoldBolts_CountCollected
hooks.about: The gold bolts collected, at most 40 (count_nonzero_entries_up_to_40): what the pause screen shows; the unspent ones are this less 4 per gold weapon.

hooks.name: Hero_TakeDamage
hooks.about: Takes hit points off the hero's health (Hero_TakeDamage): at most one a call, none for 0, then the HUD's health bank. Every hit the hero takes goes through it but the instant kills (falls, crushers), which set his health to 0.

hooks.name: Moby_GetHitMessage
hooks.about: The hit pending on moby (MobyGetHitMessage): the record of the last hit posted to it (+0x20 the attacker, +0x24 the flags, +0x2C the damage, an f32) when its flags match mask, else 0, dropping the hit unless keep. How the hero and every enemy read the hits they take, each tick, so a hit may be read more than once.

hooks.name: Weapon_TakeAmmo
hooks.about: Takes amount of ammo from item for a shot (TakeAmmo; -1 is the item in hand): 1 when taken, 0 when there is too little. An item with no ammo limit takes none and gives 1.

hooks.name: Moby_RecordDeath
hooks.about: Records a placed moby's death or a crate's break (SetDeathBits): its save id's killed bits (none for a save id below 0), its mission, then drops its bolts: about the s16 at +0xB4 (or what a tallied source has left of +0xB6), which it then clears.

hooks.name: Level_LoadGameplay
hooks.about: Loads a level's gameplay file into the level heap (LoadLevelGameplay), once per level start: the settings, the placed mobys and their pvars, the spare moby pool, the paths and the rest; returns the heap cursor. After it, every placed moby exists and none has run.

hooks.name: Hero_ApproachSpeed
hooks.about: Eases the hero's ground speed (+0x194, the speed Hero_SetPlanarVelocity moves him at) toward his target speed (+0x190) by up when below it and by down when above, each tick he moves on foot, in every level.

hooks.name: Ship_TravelTo
hooks.about: The ship's travel from the planet select (ShipTravelTo), once its menu closes: to the planet it is on (dest the level now), the landing again, as backing out of the select does; to another, the game saved to the card and the ship's flight out of the level, whose loop then ends and flies to dest. After the take-off; a level's only way to another planet by ship.

hooks.name: Moby_CollectBolt
hooks.about: Collects a bolt (collect_bolt), called by the bolt update (classes 13 to 16) once the bolt reaches the hero: adds its value (1, or 5 / 20 / 50 for classes 14 / 15 / 16) to the bolt count, the level's total and its source's stats, shows the bolt counter and makes two sparkles at it. The bolt update then deletes the bolt (a placed one marked taken) whether or not this ran.

hooks.name: Menu_ItemGrid_Update
hooks.about: Moves the pause menu item grid's focus and takes its selection (update_menu_grid_selection), each tick the grid is open. Returns the menu's action.

hooks.name: Menu_ItemGrid_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the pause menu item grid (draw_menu_item_grid). Returns the render-pass flags the menu passes on.

hooks.name: Menu_ItemSlots_Update
hooks.about: Puts the highlighted item in one of the quick select's eight slots (update_menu_item_slots), in the pause menu's quick select editor.

hooks.name: Menu_QuickSelect_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the pause menu's quick select ring (draw_pause_ring). Returns the render-pass flags.

hooks.name: Menu_QuickSelect_Load
hooks.about: Copies the eight saved quick select items into the pause menu's editor (load_selection_list).

hooks.name: Menu_QuickSelect_Store
hooks.about: Copies the editor's eight quick select items (+0x30 of screen) back to the saved quick select (pause_stage_sprite_lists).

hooks.name: Menu_ItemText_Draw
hooks.about: Draws a menu text label from its configuration (render_configured_text_label): the selected item's name and description among others.

hooks.name: Menu_ItemAmmo_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the selected item's ammo panel in the pause menu (draw_selected_item_ammo).

hooks.name: Menu_Preview_Bind
hooks.about: Binds the selected item, and what it carries, to the pause menu's preview (update_item_preview_binding).

hooks.name: Menu_Preview_Update
hooks.about: Makes or replaces the moby of the pause menu's item preview (update_item_preview_moby).

hooks.name: Menu_Preview_DrawAvailable
hooks.about: Draws the preview mobys of the owned, selected item (draw_available_item_preview_mobys). Returns the render-pass flags.

hooks.name: Menu_Preview_DrawSelected
hooks.about: Draws the selected item's preview, or the message for an item not owned (draw_item_preview_screen).

hooks.name: Menu_EquippedPreview_Update
hooks.about: Loads the preview of the gadget or weapon in hand (LoadHandGadget).

hooks.name: Menu_EquippedPreview_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the pause menu's preview of the hero and what he holds (draw_menu_preview_objects).

hooks.name: Hud_QuickSelect_Init
hooks.about: Sets up the quick select's eight-slot selector in play (initialize_eight_slot_hud_selector).

hooks.name: Hud_QuickSelect_Update
hooks.about: The quick select in play, each tick (update_hud_item_selector_selection_and_visibility): its focus, whether it shows, and the item chosen.

hooks.name: Hud_QuickSelect_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the quick select's item icons in play (draw_hud_item_selector_panel).

hooks.name: Vendor_MenuUpdate
hooks.about: The vendor's purchase menu, each tick it is open (update_vendor_purchase): buying items and ammo.

hooks.name: Vendor_InitializeSelected
hooks.about: Sets up the mobys and text of the vendor's selected row (initialize_vendor_selected_item_mobys).

hooks.name: Ammo_ChooseDrop
hooks.about: Chooses the ammo a dying moby or a broken crate drops (ChooseDropItem): writes the item to out_item and returns how many pickups.

hooks.name: Ammo_SpawnDrop
hooks.about: Makes an ammo pickup moby of item at pos (spawn_on_path); amount -1 takes the item's own. Returns the moby, or 0.

hooks.name: Save_Prepare
hooks.about: Writes the game's state into a save and starts a full memory card write (prepare_save_game).

hooks.name: Save_RequestAutosave
hooks.about: Writes the save's packets and asks for their memory card update (memcard_Save), as an autosave does.

hooks.name: Save_Restore
hooks.about: Restores a whole save from memory (memcard_RestoreGame); a new game's default state goes through it too. The port keeps the player's options around it (rac1/host/options.c).

hooks.name: Save_RestoreData
hooks.about: Restores one checked save packet (memcard_RestoreData); loading a file calls it directly. Returns non-zero when it took the packet.

hooks.name: Save_NewGame
hooks.about: A new game (NewGameInit): the disc's default state, and level 0. The port's --level N runs around it (rac1/host/boot.c).

hooks.name: Save_NewGamePlus
hooks.about: Challenge mode's start (load_level_zero_preserving_progress): the game reset to level 0 with the progress it carries kept.

hooks.name: Save_Serialize
hooks.about: Writes the whole save into out (memcard_MakeWholeSave), with no memory card access.

hooks.name: Save_UpdateState
hooks.about: The memory card's state machine, each tick (memcard_update_state): saves and loads go through it.

hero.about: The hero's state (HERO in the port's rac1/host C).

fields.name: hero.facing
fields.about: The way he faces (rot.z), in radians.

fields.name: hero.move_yaw
fields.about: Where the stick moves him: the stick's angle plus the camera's yaw.
